ELCIA Tech Summit
Friday, July 26, 2024
9:30 AM  7:00 PM

The ELCIA - Electronics City Industries Association Tech Summit 2024 was a remarkable event, starting with inspiring opening remarks by Mr. N. R. Narayana Murthy to thought-provoking panels on Generative AI, Industry 4.0, and Aerospace technology.
Our startups also had the exciting opportunity to engage with visionaries like Mohandas Pai, making the event even more impactful.
